meta.title: About Us | Co-Ownership Property
meta.description: Meet David and Dylan Olsson. Founded by father and son in 2022, COP grew from twenty years helping buyers find a place in the French Alps.
meta.ogDescription: It started with a familiar conversation in the Alps. Meet the people behind COP.

hero.lead: Founded in 2022 by David Olsson and his son, Dylan, COP brings a personal approach to finding and owning your second home.

story.kicker: From the Alps to a new idea
story.quote: The clients I had worked with for years still wanted to buy — they just couldn't afford to anymore. They were simply priced out.
paragraphs: After more than twenty years helping buyers find homes in the French Alps, David kept hearing the same story. Clients who had spent years returning to the mountains still wanted a place of their own, but rising prices had put buying outright beyond their reach. Their connection to those places had not changed; what they could afford had. Co-ownership offered a way to own a share of a home they loved, with the costs shared and a professional team looking after it.

In 2022, David founded COP with his son, Dylan, to help buyers explore that possibility. COP’s approach starts with understanding where people want to be, how they want to spend their time and what works for their budget. The aim is to help people find a second home that fits the life they actually live, with clear information and someone to talk to along the way.

people.name: David Olsson
paragraphs: David still works in French Alps real estate, with over twenty years spent selling ski properties across more than forty resorts.
He founded COP with his son, Dylan, in 2022 because he believes exceptional homes should be owned by people who love them—not only those who can afford to buy them outright.

people.name: Dylan Olsson
paragraphs: Raised between London and Marbella, with roots across four countries, Dylan grew up between languages and cultures. That international background shapes how he works with people looking for a home abroad.
A business graduate from the University of Manchester, he co-founded COP and leads sales, working closely with buyers to find the right home.

people.name: Poppy
paragraphs: Takes a zero-tolerance approach to squirrels, postmen and unauthorised cats.
Has been known to accept bribes in the form of cheddar cheese or belly rubs.

steps.h: Tell us what you have in mind.
steps.p: A destination you love, the time you want to spend there, your budget. You do not need to have everything worked out.

steps.h: Speak to a person. See the figures.
steps.p: We reply within one working day with real availability and the figures for the homes that fit. If a home does not suit your plans, we say so.

steps.h: Meet the team behind the home.
steps.p: We introduce you to the people who manage the property, so you can ask about the home, the ownership and how your stays will work.
From the first conversation through to your purchase, we stay involved and help you get the answers you need.
